Kyalami Grand Prix Circuit — survey

South Africa · theme green · day circuit · sha 3fb14ff (branch cursor/kyalami-survey-a1, lighting PR #1979 merged) · 39 frames

Highveld circuit (Gauteng), 4522 m real / 4480 m built, run clockwise in-engine (reverse:true; the brief says 'anticlockwise' by official site — source conflict). 39 frames captured: dry-day orbit+eye at 6 lap positions, five weathers at day (incl. storm) at 3 positions, dusk and night dry/rain at 3 positions. All offline audits pass; the main visual issues are tree species/shape (conifer look), unlit night, and a too-prominent tower skyline.

Ranked defects

  1. 1. Trees read as European conifers, not Highveld gum/thorn scenery/kyalami.js:72,483,450; js/track/scenery/nature.js:555-558,560-564 — Blue-gum rows and woodlots use tree(...,{crown:'columnar'}), built as 3 stacked cones (spire); default tree() is also a cone stack; forestEdge pineFrac 0.08 adds 55 real pines. Dominant in frames 2,4,5,6. Contradicts brief ('never lush', acacia + gum).
    Fix: Use a lobed/open eucalypt crown (treeOptions crown:'lobed') or fewer, narrower gum rows; set pineFrac 0; keep acacia as the only wide crown. Engine option change belongs in nature.js.
  2. 2. Night/dusk lit with no source; sky flat black js/circuits/kyalami.js:16,(night:false, furniture.lamp:'none'); lighting presets — Frames 34–39 show strong warm light pools on road and verge with no lamps, lit buildings or stars; sky is uniform black. Mechanism not traced (guess: generic night fill/headlight pool in js/lighting). Dusk shows heavy yellow haze.
    Fix: Decide intent: if Kyalami is day-only, clamp night to dusk look or add track-side lighting; otherwise author lamp furniture. Hand to lighting-tuner.
  3. 3. Tower cluster on skyline too prominent scenery/kyalami.js:331-337 (9 podium blocks, 26–62 m high at 320–530 m), 554-557 — Grey high-rise cluster dominates the right horizon in frames 4,5,14,23,26; brief wants Johannesburg as 'a faint smudge'.
    Fix: Shorten (e.g. ≤30 m), push beyond 600 m or tint toward fog colour; check against 0.0022 fog.
  4. 4. Fog does not reach the sky js/lighting/atmosphere.js (engine) — not circuit — Frames 22–24: ground washes out but the zenith stays saturated blue, giving a hard seam at the ridge line. Guess: fog tint applied to geometry only; not verified in code.
    Fix: Blend zenith toward fogColor with density; engine-level, report to lighting owner.
  5. 5. Scrub 'bushes' render as bare green pyramids scenery/kyalami.js:53-60 (bush every 24, SCRUB colours) — Frames 3,6,9,10: small cone/pyramid shapes with saturated green read as artificial markers on straw ground; SCRUB colour in source is tan [.44,.40,.22] yet renders green (likely palette/material tint).
    Fix: Verify bush() mesh and colour path; flatten to low wide mounds or drop.
  6. 6. Grandstand/terrace posts pass through seating; orbit camera ends up inside stand at s≈0 scenery/kyalami.js:187-190,246-249,205,216-262 — Frame 1/7: oxide posts are drawn through the crowd rows (front post at inw*5.6 vs row 0 lat 5.6) and crowd cubes look like stacked bricks; orbit at frac 0 is blocked by the stand (shot log: blocked fence).
    Fix: Move front posts to lat inw*6.4 beyond row 0; use a thinner crowd texture; camera issue is tool-side.
  7. 7. Built length and turn count disagree with sources js/circuits/kyalami.js:42,55-64; docs/tracks/kyalami.md — Built 4480 m vs 4522 m official (−0.9 %); def.turns has 13, trackInfo 11, brief 16; sector splits are 1/3-ish approximations.
    Fix: Report only: fix belongs in path import/turns (new-track).
  8. 8. Gallery parser does not know 'storm' tools/track/build-gallery.cjs:42 WEATHER_TAIL — day-storm frames fall through: tod 'unknown' / sector 'orbit-f17-day'. Same for any future storm shot.
    Fix: Add storm to the regex alternation (and splitTodWeather TOD list is fine).
  9. 9. Storm job shows a queued AI field; other jobs do not tools/shot/shot.mjs weather path — Frames 25–27 contain ~15 cars on the road at lap 0.5; dry frames a single car. Likely the live weather() path restarts the race; not traced.
    Fix: Check if intentional; affects framing consistency.
